interactives.label: Garden well
interactives.text: Cold water from the garden well.

interactives.label: Cache
interactives.text: A cache; it opens your shared storage.

interactives.label: Bench
interactives.text: A bench for ordinary mixing and crafting.

interactives.label: Cache
interactives.text: A cache; it opens your shared storage.

interactives.label: Bench
interactives.text: A bench for ordinary mixing and crafting.

interactives.label: The stair's slope
interactives.text: The anchor stone moved and the stair kept its slope. What is made under the temple is counted twice, once for the work and once for the climb.

interactives.label: Training post
interactives.text: The post lists your recent combat results.

interactives.label: Reading
interactives.text: The stair-house's under-room. Books read three times as fast.

interactives.label: The anchor
interactives.text: The anchor stone was moved a few metres upslope. The rigger says the ropes were re-run the same night.

interactives.label: The nine lost
interactives.text: Nine were lost on the stair in one season, and the coal price doubled the next.

interactives.label: Warm spring
interactives.text: The spring is warm and mineral; it restores you.

interactives.label: Butts
interactives.text: The butts list your recent combat results.

interactives.label: The bulb bed
interactives.text: The physick's bulb bed is where the venom bulbs are grown, not gathered. Nobody says so.

interactives.label: The socket
interactives.text: The anchor's empty socket still takes rain. The stair drains toward it.

interactives.label: The summit
interactives.text: The summit watch was built to watch the stair, not the sky.

interactives.label: The Ridge Shrine Reliquary
interactives.text: Opened with a feather from the canopy.

interactives.label: Ward post
interactives.text: Nothing casts within these stones. The post lists your recent combat results.

interactives.label: Cistern
interactives.text: Rainwater from the cistern.

interactives.label: Breath
interactives.text: Rest here and the breath comes back twice as fast.

interactives.label: Climbing
interactives.text: A rope crossing carries you where the walk grid says it does. If the deck is not walkable on the server you will not be let onto it.

sections.name: The Cenote Hollow
sections.label: An arch so grown with vine it reads as hedge.
sections.note: A side-hollow of the cenote where the cress grows thick and the bulbs are left alone.

sections.name: The Under-Garden
sections.label: An arch so grown with vine it reads as hedge.
sections.note: The hanging gardens' cellar terrace, where the gardeners grow what the tourists do not see.

sections.name: The Provisioner's Cache
sections.label: A cellar hatch under the leaves.
sections.note: The provisioner's cellar: a chest, a bench and the bulbs off the books.

sections.name: The Great Temple Vault
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: The temple's strongroom, under the processional.

sections.name: The Quarry Pit
sections.label: A loose stone in the rock; something moves behind it.
sections.note: A quarry cell the stair-house stocks with gliders for the young to learn the air on.

sections.name: The Stair-House School
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: Where the stair wardens learn the stair.

sections.name: The Water Shrine Spring
sections.label: A loose stone in the rock; something moves behind it.
sections.note: The shrine's warm feed, in a chamber behind the basin.

sections.name: The East Lookout Butts
sections.label: A cellar hatch under the leaves.
sections.note: A gallery under the lookout with herons at the far end.

sections.name: The Ridge Shrine Reliquary
sections.label: A shrine slab with fresh scratches where it has been slid aside.
sections.note: Opened with a feather from the canopy.

sections.name: The Cenote Well
sections.label: A loose stone in the rock; something moves behind it.
sections.note: Limestone drinks every spell here; the lynx penned below does not need one.

sections.name: The Sun Pavilion Focus
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: Under the sun pavilion the ether pools; spells cost half.

sections.name: The Culvert
sections.label: An arch so grown with vine it reads as hedge.
sections.note: An aqueduct culvert under the border, out into the ruins.

sections.name: The Stair Waystone
sections.label: A cracked flagstone that rings hollow underfoot.
sections.note: Two stones under the upper court. An iron rune wakes them.

sections.name: The Summit Eyrie
sections.label: An arch so grown with vine it reads as hedge.
sections.note: A pocket under the summit watch.

secrets.note: Each section is one secret. The client shows a player only the section they stand in; the server places the arrival, the areas, the spawns and the harvest nodes from this block.

provenance.geometry: authored with the secret rooms kit over the shared toolkit

notes: 14 secrets of Verdant Stair Secrets on one map with void between them; which one a player gets is which feature of the ground above they used.
